trigger: Parent/user direction: resolve the W2 0.6 gap and the unmodelled +7 wall walk, W1/W2 top landings and wall/tower connections before review.

diagnosis.W2_gap: baseline-before-wallwalk W2 was a freestanding 2.8 x 2.8 square at (78,62). Its nearest corner stood 0.512 off the SE curtain's inner face (exact, validate.py C7). It touched no wall, so its top could not reach the walk.
diagnosis.W1: W1 was a 2.8 square abutting the cross wall (0.089 gap). Nothing was drawn at +7: no landing, no opening in any parapet.
diagnosis.impossible_rise: Both squares claimed a +0 to +7 climb inside a 2.8 run, a 68.2 degree pitch. No stair can fit there, so the footprints themselves had to change.
diagnosis.missing_model: design.json had no wall-walk geometry: no deck, parapet, tower platform, doorway or landing. The prior validator listed the wall walk as untested. Its absence was never a measured pass.
diagnosis.charitable_reconstruction: The old squares were read as +7 tops beside today's decks, with no rail openings (none were drawn), and flooded at r 0.45. Neither top connects to the wall walk: W1 is false, W2 is false.

design_decision: Each wall stair becomes a solid masonry straight flight built against its host wall. Each has 25 risers x 0.28 = 7.0 and 24 goings x 0.35 = 8.4, a 38.7 degree pitch, a 1.4 clear tread and a 0.2 outer guard. W1 ends on a 1.4 x 1.4 +7 landing that joins the cross-wall deck through a 1.4 opening in its west rail. W2 runs up the SE curtain face. Its head passes through a 1.4 open-topped gap in the SE tower shell onto the tower's +7 platform. All towers are open +7 platforms that the decks pass through, so no tower changes level. Gates and the postern are crossed on vaults.

remaining_limits: 2D plan sampling on a 0.1 grid; clearances are exact only at cell centres. This is not a navmesh or a continuous 3D test.

All heights (riser, going, parapets, soffits) are proposed values checked arithmetically. Avatar radius 0.45 comes from the run context. The 2.15 mesh height is in current-hero.py authored units; its runtime scale is unmeasured.
Flights are checked by width, rules and connected head/foot, not by simulated sloped movement. No runtime stair mechanic is proposed.
In game, the camera cutaway (south faces cut to 1.2) would hide the walk on south-facing walls. Unresolved; listed as an open question.
Tower roofs above +7 are merlons only. Closed gates, portcullis or doors on the walk, combat and structure are not modelled.
The courtyard guard-route margin at the W2 landing is tight (+0.052) by design.
Site, orientation and landscape approach remain provisional. The island is not designed here.
